user.title: Godox mesh network keys
user.description: Paste the network key and app key pulled from the Godox app's own database (see the project README's "How the keys were found" section). Pick a provisioner address this installation hasn't used before -- different from the Godox app's own address (0x0100 / 256) and from any other controller (another Home Assistant instance, the project's own `godox_mesh.py` script, etc.) on the same mesh.

error.no_light_found: No light on this mesh answered. Close the Godox app and any other tool connected to it, make sure a light is powered on and in range, then try again.
